counting_policy: Unique inventory names: 118 original sided/window columns plus 87 extensions/candidate entries; exactly 14 canonical H2H columns, no aliases. Candidate entries in 2.8+ are not sided/window-expanded or independent statistical concepts. Contracts/source rows/validators are infrastructure, not implemented sporting features. Available code without accredited real sporting values remains blocked.

coverage.blocked_families: 0/4344 accredited targets for strength, advanced/keeper, player/lineup, discipline, objective context and news; xG numeric means/bilateral 0/4344. Non-null zero sample counts are diagnostic, not accredited xG sporting values.

data_fingerprint.comparison: every path, content SHA-256 and mtime_ns; only __pycache__/*.pyc/*.pyo ignored

known_gaps: Opponent results lineage/identity before each adjusted historical fixture is unaccredited; current standings have no as-of snapshots.
Capped observed form/streak/H2H histories do not certify all fixtures or true uncensored streaks; H2H under 3 samples stays null.
No accredited historical xG revision/publication evidence; xG code exists but numeric means remain blocked.
No permitted structured advanced/goalkeeper/player/official XI/minutes/card/context/news historical stream.
TXT/HTML isolated expected XI, ratings, injury/red-card absences, coaches and preview lack publication accreditation and stable player IDs.
No complete fixture/event/appointment ledgers, historical tables with rules/tiebreaks or licensed corpus.
Model performance, market value and calibration have not been evaluated; cards/corners are future contracts only.
leakage_controls: Allowlisted raw history only for scores/H2H; labels/backtest_pool/result/Champion/confidence/lambda outputs excluded from feature computation.
Target, same-day, future and unknown identity/date historical matches excluded; all duplicate copies excluded.
Exact regulation score grammar and current-team orientation; no current standings as history.
No xG/stats/player/news publication inferred from file mtime or match date; independent availability evidence required.
Prematch target snapshots require independently verified publication/revision strictly before decision cutoff; predicted XI and official XI distinct.
Null plus reason; no zero-fill, imputation, retrospective backfill or relaxation of completeness/permission gates.
H2H auxiliary separated from recent_form; bounded observed windows do not imply complete fixture ledger.
No private psychological state or productive sentiment features.

operational_backup_fingerprint.comparison: every path, content SHA-256 and mtime_ns; only __pycache__/*.pyc/*.pyo ignored

recommendations_for_phase_3: Freeze allowed feature inventory and snapshot lineage; prevent blocked candidates and xG diagnostic zeros from entering training.
Evaluate baseline form/streaks first with time-based splits; add H2H only in auxiliary ablation with sample/partial flags.
Keep the canonical H2H inventory without aliases; do not promote missingness into inferred sporting zeros.
Secure a permission-backed provider with stable IDs and historical publication/revision snapshots before P1 ingestion.
Accredit full fixture/event/minutes/appointment coverage and competition rules before rest/load/cards/context.
Keep news P3 experimental and bounded; independently verify publication evidence and extraction quality before any model use.
